quote: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency, making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of every other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Stop and remain in such position until the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle has passed.

activation.condition: immediate approach of a qualifying emergency or regulatory vehicle using required flashing lamps, unless otherwise directed by an officer

obligation.description: stop and remain in such position until the qualifying approaching vehicle has passed, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: An officer may direct a different response; original direction remains unverified.

timing.description: upon immediate approach until the whole approaching vehicle has passed; no invented numeric cutoff

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle or official regulatory vehicle using qualifying flashing lights
judgment_calls_needed.note: Authority, lamps, approach timing and any officer direction require original source and pixel review.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: stop and remain in such position until the vehicle has passed
judgment_calls_needed.note: Record original subject stop, full bodies and first movement against full-body passage; synthetic requests do not prove the physical event.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
judgment_calls_needed.note: Verify original officer identity, direction content, recipient and time; visible stand-in alone is insufficient.
